verdict.rationale: Restate ships as a single self-contained server binary with a CLI for managing services, deployments and invocations, plus an admin API, so it can be driven entirely without a UI. Its TypeScript testing library runs the Restate Server in a Docker container via Testcontainers, which fits automated test pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive CLI flags or output formats, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Restate is a single self-contained binary. No external dependencies needed.
You can use the CLI to interact with Restate, and manage your services, deployments and invocations.
This uses [Testcontainers](https://testcontainers.com/) to run a Restate Server in a Docker container and let you test your Restate handlers.
To call a function over HTTP, send a request to the Restate Server, specifying the service and the function you want to invoke.
